args.question: List the top 5 selling products (sku_desc) by total units_sold for last month (July 2025) from transaction_data table.

stateDelta.sql_query:
SELECT
    t.sku_desc,
    SUM(t.unit_sold) AS total_units_sold
  FROM
    `acn-cda.RMN_Campaign_Data_AgentTest.transaction_data` AS t
  WHERE
    t.transaction_date >= '2025-07-01'
    AND t.transaction_date < '2025-08-01'
  GROUP BY
    t.sku_desc
  ORDER BY
    total_units_sold DESC
  LIMIT 5
